name: I Too Like To Live Dangerously
look: Movie still of Mike Myers as Austin Powers, with shaggy brown hair and thick black glasses, wearing a red velvet suit and a white lace ruffled shirt. He gives a sly, toothy smirk in a dim casino with people in formal wear behind him.
use: Treats a tiny, harmless act as if it were daring. The top text describes the barely risky thing someone does and the bottom adds "I too like to live dangerously."
slots: I too like to live dangerously (bottom text)
examples: Uses the phone at 2% battery with no charger nearby
I too like to live dangerously
Eats yogurt one day after the date on the lid
I too like to live dangerously

guy with glasses and a frilly shirt smiling slyly at a casino

mike myers smug smile in a ruffled shirt about taking risks

origin: Mike Myers as Austin Powers in the casino scene of Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997).
